meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 安装并认证后,助手能通过 WhatsApp 收发消息,并按 WhatsApp 格式回复。绑定您日常使用的号码时,它只回应您与它自己的聊天,别人发给您的消息完全不看;绑定专用号码时,所有发给该号码的消息都由它处理。
howto.when: 当您要求为 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 频道、绑定现有号码,或提出要通过 WhatsApp 使用助手时,开始执行安装与认证。

say.text: 帮我添加 WhatsApp 频道,用我现在的号码。
say.note: 它会先提示共享号码的风险,需您确认才继续。
终端会显示二维码,用手机扫码完成配对。
手机上输入 8 位配对码,约 60 秒内有效。

howto.what_en: After setup, the agent can send and receive WhatsApp messages with WhatsApp formatting. Shared number: it replies only in your self-chat and ignores other messages. Dedicated: it handles everything sent to that number.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask NanoClaw to add a WhatsApp channel, connect an existing WhatsApp number, or make the assistant reachable through WhatsApp.

say_en.text: Add WhatsApp using my current number.
say_en.note: It will first show the shared-number risk warning.
A QR code appears in the terminal; scan it with your phone.

say_en.text: Link with a pairing code, number 14155551234.
say_en.note: Enter the 8-char code on your phone within ~60 seconds.
